subject: Error message from spatially estimating vaccine effectiveness in Cox proportional hazard model

messages.author: 73118a659783f3d7
messages.subject: Error message from spatially estimating vaccine effectiveness in Cox proportional hazard model
parts:
Dear all

I am trying to implement spatial effects to the Cox proportional hazard model to estimate vaccine effectiveness but R is giving me error. Please, here is the code and the error message:

# Define the formula for the Cox model with spatial effects formula <- as.formula(Surv(tstart, tstop, status) ~ Age + Sex + Race_cat + Condition + Tobaco_Use + Autoimmune_Disorder + previous.positive + vaccinated + f(ZCTA5CE10, model = ICAR,graph = adjacency_matrix)) # Fit the model using INLA fit <- inla(formula, family = "coxph", data = Given, control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, config = TRUE)) Error in inla.coxph(formula, data, control.hazard, debug = debug) : For survival models, then the reponse has to be of class `inla.surv'; you have `list' *** inla.core.safe: inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/1 Error in inla.coxph(formula, data, control.hazard, debug = debug) : For survival models, then the reponse has to be of class `inla.surv'; you have `list' Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts, : *** Failed to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.

Please, what am I doing wrong and how do I correct it?
